name: Dereva Prep
description: Driving-test prep app for Kenyan learner drivers, built around the model town board that many students fail on.
longDescription: Dereva Prep helps Kenyan learner drivers prepare for the driving test. I started it as a student at driving school, after I saw more than 40 students in one class struggle with the model town board. The app runs on a KSh 500 monthly subscription. I grow it with Facebook and TikTok ads and use PostHog to find where the funnel loses people.
